title: Aromatic Uruguayan Broccoli Gratin
description: A low-carb-friendly, flavorful gratin from Uruguay, featuring boiled broccoli in a tangy bechamel sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Blanch the broccoli for 3-4 minutes or until tender.
Drain the broccoli and set it aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking continuously to prevent lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it thickens.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the Gruyère cheese until melted.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange the blanched broccoli in an even layer.
Pour the cheese sauce over the broccoli.
Dot the top of the gratin with the remaining 4 tablespoons of butter.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
